observations: The page number «44» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01: «Apogeum» continues «Subtrahieren wir davon das» at the end of p. 43 (JP2 0075, L34).

A figure stands at the left of L17-L25, which are set in a narrower measure at its right; it is not reproduced. Two circles of the same radius: the eccentric with the centre M, on which lie A at the left end of the dashed horizontal diameter, F at the upper left, G and S at the lower left, and P at the right end of the diameter; and the circle of the ecliptic with the centre E, which passes through P′ at the right end of the same dashed line. The solid lines F M, S M produced to H, H E and S E; the dashed line G M, parallel to S E; the angle α marked twice, at S between S M and S E, and at M between M G and M S; L38 calls the triangle H E S right-angled. The letters are italic: A, M, E, P, P′, F, G, H, S, α.

L01-L05. Checked: 131° 0′ 34″ − 77° 55′ = 53° 5′ 34″; 131° 0′ 34″ − 1° 46′ = 129° 14′ 34″, which is 9° 14′ 34″ of Leo (from 120°). The equation of 1° 46′ is to be compared with Table 22. L15-L32. Checked: A, M and E lie on one line with M between A and E, so that ∢ AMS is the exterior angle of the triangle EMS at M and equals ∢ MES + ∢ MSE, that is ∢ AES + α; the true anomaly ∢ AES is the mean anomaly less the equation α, and ∢ AMG = ∢ AES and ∢ GMS = α, since MG ∥ ES.

L07: «(p. 9—10 : Quod si ab argumento partes aliquae restiterint . . .)», the quotation in italics, the colon after a thin space (12 px), three points. L19, L21, L22, L24, L27-L29, L38: «∢», the angle sign, a < with a short stroke across it, set before the italic letters with a space. L28: «MG ∥ ES», the sign of parallels printed as two vertical strokes.

L31: the h of «Gleichung» is a bold sort. N04: «11₃» (the third series), the 11 bold and the 3 lowered. L33: a dark speck below the e of «jeden»; L30: a speck on the base line after «wird»; not transcribed.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Ptol.-Batt.», «Ptol.», «Batt.», «al-Bīrūnī», «Nallino», «Heiberg», «Manitius»; italics: the letters of the figure, «Apogeum», «Anomalie» (L01), «Gleichung» (L02, L27), «wahren Ort», «mittlere Anomalie», «Argument», «wahre Anomalie», «wahre Länge», «Almagest», «Biblioth. mathem.».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-13 px measured).
